description: Cancel a batch. Its checks that haven't gone to the checking service yet stop and cost nothing, unless another batch still wants them or check_email_address asked for them. A check already sent to the service finishes, because it may already count, and if that call fails it is not sent again. A batch already canceled or finished is answered as it is: a finished batch has nothing left to stop, and retry_email_check_run still works on it.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: cancel_email_check_run
title: Cancel a batch of checks
